**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The document already delivers our preferred IP position:

- **Customer Data / pre-existing IP (§14.1):** We own all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited right to process it to provide, secure, support and improve the Services *for us*. Reinforced by §15.1 (no sale, advertising use, commingling or model training without our written consent).
- **Deliverables (§14.2):** Vest in Customer on creation, with an express Vendor assignment of worldwide right, title and interest, equivalent personnel assignments, and further-assurance cooperation.
- **Vendor IP with licence-back (§14.3 + §13.2):** Vendor retains only "Vendor Technology" (defined to exclude Customer Data and our pre-existing IP), and any Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable carries the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works and have contractors support it — plus pre-delivery disclosure and a bar on restrictive third-party material.
- **No joint ownership (§14.4):** Expressly negated absent a signed instrument specifying exploitation rights; feedback use is limited and we keep unrestricted rights in our own feedback.

Searches for assignment, ownership, and aggregated/de-identified data language surfaced nothing that shifts our IP or data to Brightline, so there is no walk-away or fallback issue to address.
